lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: THE ENTIRE CEILING IS COMING DOWN [beat] WE NEED TO GRAB THOSE FILES AND RUN BEFORE THE BULLDOZERS REACH THE MAIN OFFICE!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: I CAN'T JUST DISCONNECT THE HARD DRIVE NIX [beat] IF I UNPLUG THIS NOW THE ENTIRE ENCRYPTION WILL LOCK US OUT FOREVER!

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: THOSE CONSTRUCTION GUYS DON'T CARE IF WE ARE INSIDE [beat] LOOK AT THE DUST CLOUD [beat] THE MAIN HALLWAY IS COMPLETELY BLOCKED!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: WAIT [beat] WHY IS THE PRINCIPAL'S SAFE ALREADY OPEN [beat] AND WHO LEFT THIS RED ENVELOPE SITTING ON TOP OF THE SECRET LEDGER?

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: YOU KIDS REALLY SHOULD HAVE STAYED AT HOME TONIGHT [beat] BECAUSE NOW YOU ARE WITNESSING A PLANNED ACCIDENT IN REAL TIME!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: PRINCIPAL HUDA [beat] YOU ARE THE ONE WHO ORDERED THE DEMOLITION EARLY [beat] YOU'RE TRYING TO BURY THE EVIDENCE LITERALLY!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: THE SCHOOL NEEDS A NEW WING [beat] AND THE INSURANCE MONEY IS FAR MORE VALUABLE THAN A FEW STUPID STUDENT PERMANENT RECORDS!

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: THE WALL JUST CRACKED [beat] NIX WE HAVE TO JUMP THROUGH THE WINDOW OR WE ARE GOING TO BE PART OF THE FOUNDATION!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I'M NOT LEAVING WITHOUT THE TRUTH [beat] RIKU FASTEN THAT CABLE [beat] I CAN SEE THE NAMES OF EVERY TEACHER ON THIS PAYROLL!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: YOU THINK YOU'RE HEROES [beat] BUT NO ONE WILL BELIEVE THREE TROUBLEMAKERS WHO BROKE INTO A CONDEMNED BUILDING AT MIDNIGHT!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: THE DOWNLOAD IS AT NINETY NINE PERCENT [beat] JUST TEN MORE SECONDS AND EVERY CRIME SHE EVER COMMITTED IS ON MY CLOUD DRIVE!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: THE FLOOR IS DISAPPEARING [beat] HUDA JUST KICKED THE SERVER RACK OVER THE EDGE [beat] RIKU HOLD ON TO MY HAND RIGHT NOW!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: THE BUILDING COLLAPSES IN A CLOUD OF DEBRIS [beat] BUT DID THE TRUTH SURVIVE THE FALL [beat] OR IS IT BURIED UNDER THE RUBBLE?
